Swap in originals later if a sharper zoom is wanted.

rejected.reason: The idea file suggests it as H. pylori, but the CDC caption says it shows "Flexispira rappini", a Helicobacter relative, not H. pylori. Also only 700x476. Do not use as "the bacteria he drank".
Real H. pylori but only 600x400 and a non-standard licence tag; not used.

assets.author: Gaius Cornelius
assets.what_it_shows: Sample jar that contained Helicobacter pylori in a broth solution. Barry Marshall intentionally drank this broth in order to test his theory that H. pylori could ulcers and gastritis. He contracted a serious infection. This proved his theory to be correct. On display at the Nobel Prize Museum.
